estimators.ratio: geometric mean of per-round paired ratios (Expanse ns / twin ns, and each arm's generator / shuffled insert), BCa 95% interval on the per-round log ratios from art_common::bca_ci_labeled (2000 resamples; construction label in <ratio>_ci_method); per-arm columns are medians of the same rounds; memory rows are exact requested and usable byte counts with no interval
estimators.columns: per-arm columns are medians of the same rounds; the ratio column is not the quotient of the two median columns beside it
estimators.raw: every cell carries rounds_raw, the per-round samples verbatim
